title: Front Office Maps, Nate's Six
sub: One new Sales Navigator map per account: the people who run customer service, the contact centers, workforce management and the service technology at six prospects. Every name checked against Salesforce and the live sequences.
legend_html: In Salesforce: Intradiem already has a record for this person; they stay on the map because they run customer service, the contact centers or workforce management. Same name elsewhere in Salesforce: a record with this name exists at another company.
md_title: # Front-office map build sheets, Nate's six
md_intro: Each sheet is one new Sales Navigator Relationship Map (cap 30). Build top-down: the customer operations executive, then the leaders of contact center operations, workforce management and service technology, then the directors under them. Reporting lines are inferred from titles; confirm each card in Sales Navigator as it is added.

account_notes.Centene: Contact centers sit under the corporate COO (Colleen Askvig) with plan-level COOs running their own member services; Fidel Ligsay's line is Health Net Federal Services. Centene's front office already has Stars wave-one names in a live sequence, so check the collision flag before adding anyone from this map to outreach.
account_notes.Fidelity Investments: Fidelity's service organization splits by business: Ashley Richter runs the Covington participant services contact center, Robert Cummings's client services line sits in Stock Plan Services, and Jessica Henck's global workforce optimization team is the enterprise WFM owner. 'Client services' at Fidelity includes brokerage client teams; the names here carry operations or contact-center words.
account_notes.National Grid: US customer operations under the Chief Customer Officer (Bill Malee) with Frederick Daum over the contact centers; UK service leaders were excluded. National Grid has PSC call-answer penalties on the record (see the back-office page signals).
account_notes.Paychex: Paychex is sales-heavy and thin at Director-plus in service operations; Elizabeth Roaldsen's operations and customer experience line is the whole map. Search 'Service Center' and 'Client Service' directly in Sales Navigator for the layer below.
account_notes.Regions Financial: Regions' contact centers roll up to Douglas Pennington (EVP, Head of Contact Center) through Vicki Yackel; the VP-level contact center managers are the operating layer. The Clay index carries few Regions directors, so the map leans on Salesforce-known names that were live-checked today.
account_notes.Truist: Kimberly Dorsett (EVP, Head of Truist Care Centers) is placed over the three SVP contact center directors and the capacity planning VP as a best guess from titles; confirm in Sales Navigator. Jamie Swider owns care center operations, workforce management and IVR. Strategic Workforce Planning at Truist is an HR function and was left off.
